comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal; record receives a terminal block from a person and mounts it onto a DIN rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Wire deflection, blade-under-tab access, and extraction versus timed handover grasp and straight-down press-to-latch rail mounting.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact and alone versus clean handover followed by centered, level, two-foot DIN-rail latching without moving the rail.
comparison.reason: Although both concern electrical components and latches, the record tests handover and snap-fit installation, not latch release.
